2028176.title: Heo Jun Festival
2028176.overview: A festival honoring Heo Jun — Joseon's greatest physician, whose 25-volume medical encyclopedia Donguibogam (1610) is inscribed in UNESCO's Memory of the World — held in the Seoul district where he was born and wrote it. Since 2023 it fills the Seoul Botanic Park lawn with traditional-medicine experiences and performances.

2754710.title: Korea Forest Expo 2025
2754710.overview: A national forestry expo at Gonjiam Ceramic Park with 50 institutions and 100 companies: forest-tech exhibitions, a national forest-interpretation contest, carbon-zero camping, and family programs on climate and green living.

3551127.title: Gimhae Music Festival 'Salmon'
3551127.overview: A citizen-run forest music festival since 2006, named for the salmon returning to its home stream — as Gimhae-raised musicians come home to play. Jazz and rock band stages with markets, food, and workshops in Gaya Theme Park.
3551127.fee: Free with reservation (park admission on site)

3545515.title: Seoriji Family Adventure Festival
3545515.overview: A family festival at Seoriji Eco Park in Daegu styled as an 'adventure forest' — visitors become heroes on a quest through nature-themed challenges and hands-on programs.

2561795.title: Yuseong Chrysanthemum Festival
2561795.overview: Yurim Park at peak chrysanthemum season: flower sculptures, fragrance, and evening performances in Daejeon's hot-spring district. Free, open late.

2952484.title: Bbang Bbang Day Cheonan
2952484.overview: The bread festival of Cheonan — a city proud of its bakery culture — gathering fresh-baked breads and desserts in one big 'bread market' at the stadium plaza, with performances and family programs. Come hungry.
2952484.sponsor: Cheonan City · Korea Bakers Association Cheonan

626944.title: Seoul Silver Grass Festival
626944.overview: Haneul (Sky) Park — a 98m hill built on Seoul's former landfill and reborn as an eco-park for the 2002 World Cup — waves with vast eulalia grass fields every October. The festival opens the park late for sunset and night walks through the silver grass with the city skyline beyond. One of Seoul's defining autumn scenes.

2858894.title: Seongju Gayasan Golden Fields Grasshopper Festival
2858894.overview: A farm-country festival in the clean valleys below Gayasan: catch grasshoppers in the rice paddies, dig sweet potatoes, fish for apples and catfish — childhood nostalgia for adults, first-time farm play for kids.

2740046.title: Hanbok Culture Week
2740046.overview: Korea's national hanbok week, held every third week of October with 330 participating venues nationwide: fashion shows, performances, and try-on programs under the banner 'Modern Hanbokpan', with satellite events in Hong Kong, New York, and Berlin.
2740046.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

506376.title: Ganggyeong Jeotgal Festival
506376.overview: Ganggyeong was once one of Joseon's three great markets, and its salted-seafood (jeotgal) trade survives as Korea's largest — this riverside festival celebrates that pungent heritage with tastings, kimchi-making with fresh jeotgal, and themed riverside lounges on the Geumgang.

1322668.title: Gokseong Simcheong Children's Festival
1322668.overview: A children's festival at the Gokseong Train Village — the steam-train theme park on the Seomjin River — built on the filial-daughter folktale of Simcheong: character shows, musicals, magic, and mission adventures through the rose garden.

142233.title: Jeongdong Culture Festival
142233.overview: A street festival on Jeongdong-gil — the stone-wall lane by Deoksugung Palace that was the diplomatic quarter of the Korean Empire. Street performances, retro arcades, pump-organ playing, and caricature booths along one of Seoul's most beloved walks.

3012429.title: Namdo Film Festival Season 2: Gwangyang
3012429.overview: A traveling film festival touring Jeonnam's 22 cities and counties — season two lands in Gwangyang, the city of light and steel, for five days of competition and open-air screenings in plazas, museums, and even container docks.

3379778.title: Garak Oktoberfest Gourmet Night
3379778.overview: A rooftop Oktoberfest on the sky garden of Garak Market — Korea's largest wholesale food market: 20 craft breweries, barbecue and camping vibes, market-fresh cooking pop-ups, and chef battles featuring Culinary Class Wars alumni.

637276.title: Iksan Ten Million Chrysanthemum Festival
637276.overview: Korea's biggest chrysanthemum festival: ten million blooms shaped into giant sculptures — phoenixes, Baekje gates, dragons — plus the country's largest chrysanthemum garden, bonsai exhibitions, music fountains, and night lighting.

234235.title: Danyang Ondal Culture Festival
234235.overview: Korea's only Goguryeo-kingdom festival, built on the legend of General Ondal and Princess Pyeonggang at Danyang's riverside drama-set park: period costume experiences, a recreated Goguryeo market street, and free entry to the Ondal filming location during the festival.

638576.title: Korea Chrysanthemum Grand Festival (Hampyeong)
638576.overview: Hampyeong's signature autumn show — 'Magic Chrysanthemum Land': carousel, ferris wheel, and giant cups built entirely of chrysanthemums across the Expo Park, with food streets under the fragrance.

2484237.title: La La La Festival
2484237.overview: Busan Geumjeong's coffee-and-bread festival on the Oncheoncheon stream below Pusan National University station — 'Drink the coffee! Eat the bread! Enjoy the culture!' — with local roasters, bakeries, and stages.

229052.title: Yangyang Salmon Festival
229052.overview: Every autumn salmon return up the Namdaecheon to spawn, and Yangyang celebrates with Korea's famous bare-hand salmon catching, salmon cooking shows, ecology programs, and riverside night stages. A living nature lesson for kids and a feast for adults.

3551526.title: Yongmaru Forest Trail Festival
3551526.overview: Nine weekend days of healing along the Gyeongui Line Forest Trail in Yongsan: busking, one-day classes, street performances, and pop-up markets with local merchants under the slogan 'my healing oasis in the city'.

3375262.title: Jeonnam World Gimbap Festival
3375262.overview: A festival for Korea's favorite seaweed roll in the province that grows most of the country's gim: specialty gimbap from all 22 Jeonnam counties, cooking competitions, live auctions, art-gimbap making, and multicultural gimbap workshops in Mokpo.
3375262.place: Mokpo Culture & Arts Center outdoor stage

3349628.title: Jeju Reading Festival
3349628.overview: Jeju's largest book festival at Udang Library: author lectures, character-costume parades, book-themed AI chats, reading clinics, and family programs under the year's theme 'utterly fallen for books'.

3377048.title: Hapcheon Hwangto Hanwoo Festival
3377048.overview: Hapcheon's red-clay-raised hanwoo beef gets a three-day showcase — 'Come! Try! Taste! Buy!' — with grill zones, performances, and county food at the sports park.

3546882.title: Music Performers Festival 2025
3546882.overview: Jeju musicians and mainstream Korean artists share a seaside stage at Tapdong Beach Theater — a festival by the musicians' union where live performance meets the ocean horizon. Free, evenings.

2860868.title: Gijang Conger Eel Festival in Chiram
2860868.overview: The 19th sea-eel festival in the fishing village of Chiram, Busan: free conger-eel bibimbap tastings, bare-hand eel catching, quiz shows, a national song contest, and fireworks over the autumn sea.

3387201.title: Yeongdeungpo Seonyudo Garden Festival
3387201.overview: Autumn on Seonyudo — the water-plant island park in the Han River rebuilt from an old filtration plant: book festival, flea market, yoga and birdwatching walks, ballet and gugak performances among the ivy-covered structures.

3551206.title: Gwangmyeong Cave Light Festival
3551206.overview: A light festival at Gwangmyeong Cave — the abandoned gold mine turned culture space — themed on the whale as a messenger of hope and climate awareness, pairing cave light art with an eco-consumption campaign.

2435280.title: Gangjin Bay Dancing Reeds Festival
2435280.overview: Sunset over the reed beds of Gangjin Bay Eco Park — home to 1,572 recorded species — with boardwalk ecology walks, performances against the estuary light, and children's nature programs.

1472205.title: Sea in the City Festival (Noryangjin)
1472205.overview: The capital's biggest seafood festival at Noryangjin Fish Market: tuna-cutting shows, auctioneer experiences, grilled-fish streets, shrimp-net fishing for kids, K-trot concerts, and direct-from-the-boat markets from fishing co-ops nationwide.
1472205.place: Noryangjin Fish Market and sports fields

1749228.title: Cheongnamdae Autumn Festival
1749228.overview: Autumn at Cheongnamdae — the former presidential villa on Daecheong Lake, opened to the public in 2003: foliage walks, chrysanthemum bonsai exhibitions, daily music performances, and a winery corner on the lakeside grounds.

3550990.title: Incheon Wondosa Rite & Nakseom Festival
3550990.overview: A revival of the Joseon-era Wondosa rite, in which Incheon's magistrate honored the spirits of the West Sea islands on Nakseom Island each spring and autumn — reenacted with a procession and village festival in Michuhol.

3551014.title: 7th Black Music Festival (BMF)
3551014.overview: Hip-hop, R&B, and soul on a former US Army base: Camp Red Cloud in Uijeongbu, used by the military for 70 years, hosts top Korean and international acts as the city reclaims the space for culture.

3406027.title: Yeosu Dongdong Drum Festival
3406027.overview: A drum festival rooted in the Goryeo-era song 'Dongdong' and General Yu Tak, Yeosu's forgotten defender: a citizen drum parade through the streets, drum competitions, EDM and guest stages at the old naval shipyard site.
3406027.place: Seonso shipyard site and Yonggi Park

3544786.title: WOW Let's Play! Yangpyeong Festa
3544786.overview: The Yangpyeong education campus becomes one big playground: booknic picnics, campus-wide treasure hunts and stamp rallies, a five-senses play zone, future-tech studio, and eco-craft workshops for families. Free.

3021124.title: Bohyeonsa Temple Millennium Culture Festival
3021124.overview: A temple festival at thousand-year-old Bohyeonsa near Gangneung: mountain-spirit rites, tea ceremonies for the temple's three great masters, healing temple concerts, Korean and Chinese tea tastings, ceramics exhibitions, and temple-food showcases.

627825.title: Jeongeupsa Culture Festival
627825.overview: Jeongeup's flagship festival since 1990, honoring the devoted wife of 'Jeongeupsa' — the only surviving Baekje-era song in Korean — with performances and programs at the culture park named for her.

3373104.title: Byeolgil Market
3373104.overview: A neighborhood culture market on the street from Gileum Station to Mia Elementary: less-waste market with local shops, a youth start-up market, art market, and jazz, dance, and magic stages — building a walkable family street.

1748721.title: Pohang Steel Art Festival 2025
1748721.overview: The steel city's signature art festival: sculptures and installations exploring iron as material and metaphor, made with artists, steel companies, and steelworkers at the Dongbin Culture Warehouse 1969 on the harbor.

3025858.title: Goyang Animal-Assisted Healing Festival
3025858.overview: A pet culture festival on Ilsan Culture Plaza themed on animal-assisted healing: pet fashion show, mini sports day, agility demos, free animal registration, behavior classes, therapy zones, and a pet run across seven themed sectors.

3384023.title: Yangcheon Family Street Festival
3384023.overview: A 900-meter stretch by Sinjeongnegeori Station becomes a family commons for a day — generations sharing each other's culture through stages, booths, and street programs.

3551562.title: 20th Humanities Week
3551562.overview: Korea's national humanities week — 29 universities and institutes sharing research with the public through lectures, exhibitions, performances, and field trips, themed 'connecting again: region and community through the humanities'.
3551562.place: National Research Foundation, Daejeon and venues nationwide

3558562.title: Urban Forest Art Healing: Garden of Quiet Breath

3011126.title: Incheon Global Education Fair
3011126.overview: An open education festival at Songdo Convensia: world-culture booths run by foreign embassies, 80 exhibition booths on Incheon's future industries — aviation, robotics, metaverse — a Hyundai future-mobility hall, and student stages.

2930716.title: Gangneung Noodle Festival
2930716.overview: Gangneung may be Korea's best noodle city — jang-kalguksu, buckwheat makguksu, potato-dumpling soup — and this festival on Wolhwa Street serves them all at 5,000 won a bowl, mapping the city's famous and hidden noodle houses.

2873042.title: Hongcheon Apple Festival
2873042.overview: Apples from Hongcheon's high valleys — Hongro, Arisu, Sinano Gold, Envy, Fuji — sold at source in the Tori Forest park, with stages, events, and autumn programs.

790124.title: Hongcheon Ginseng & Hanwoo Festival
790124.overview: Hongcheon's flagship harvest festival pairing its six-year ginseng with local hanwoo beef: direct farm sales, grill zones, folk games with residents and the local army garrison, and full days of stages in the Tori Forest.

2039752.title: Wolchulsan Chrysanthemum Festival
2039752.overview: Chrysanthemum sculptures and photo zones fill Gichan Land at the foot of Wolchulsan — the jagged 'Matterhorn of the south' — for a fragrant, free autumn stroll in Yeongam.

1122739.title: Yanggu Punchbowl Siraegi & Apple Festival
1122739.overview: A harvest festival in the Punchbowl — the famous crater-like basin near the DMZ in Yanggu — celebrating its two specialties: siraegi (dried radish greens) and highland apples, with markets and programs at the healing house grounds.

3381612.title: Jeonju Makgeolli Festival
3381612.overview: Jeonju's rice-wine festival: classic makgeolli with its perfect companions — yukjeon, samhap, pajeon — alongside fruit makgeolli and cocktail shows for younger drinkers, moju-brewing workshops, and fusion-gugak-to-EDM stages.
